column8:
How to make it work for you. 

Go to the top left corner - click on "File"
From the drop down menu select the 4th choice - "Make a copy"
This will make a copy on YOUR google drive. 
Go to your copy. 
Type what you want to search on the yellow box. Press enter.
Give 10 seconds for search result to appear.

It is not as fast as other searches as it uses a script inside the google sheet.
